stories.title: WNBA playoffs: How Ogunbowale's historic 45 points saved the Wings' season
stories.summary: Dallas rallied to force a decisive Game 3 and Arike Ogunbowale made history.

stories.title: Steelers to trade CB Porter to Cowboys for pair of picks, sources say
stories.summary: The Steelers have agreed to trade cornerback Joey Porter Jr. to the Cowboys for a 2027 sixth-round pick and a 2028 second-rounder, sources confirmed to ESPN.

stories.title: Yanks ride homegrown stars to one-sided sweep of Red Sox; Rays await in ALDS
stories.summary: The Yankees' homegrown talent such as Ben Rice and Cam Schlittler led the way to help deliver a thorough two-game beatdown of the Red Sox in their AL Wild Card Series, ending with Wednesday's 9-2 win.

stories.title: Red Sox's Gray 'frustrated' by lack of trust from manager in loss to Yankees
stories.summary: Red Sox ace Sonny Gray said after Wednesday's loss to the Yankees that he was frustrated for being lifted after throwing only 70 pitches.

stories.title: Ogunbowale saves Wings' season, breaks playoff record with 45 in OT classic
stories.summary: Arike Ogunbowale delivered a record-breaking performance with the Wings' season on the line, scoring 45 points, including a tying 3-pointer to force overtime, to help Dallas force a deciding Game 3 against the Valkyries.
